test_numpy_int_proto: test assigning numpy int64 and uint64 scalars and 1D arrays to protobuf repeated and scalar fields
test_numpy_float_proto: test assigning numpy float64 scalars and 1D arrays to protobuf repeated float fields
test_numpy_bool_proto: test assigning numpy bool scalars and 1D arrays to protobuf repeated bool fields
test_numpy_indexing: test indexing protobuf repeated fields with numpy int64 scalar indices including negative indexing
test_numpy_type_errors: test that assigning 2D arrays or wrong dtype numpy arrays to protobuf fields raises TypeError
